title: verdict's scratch-HOME proofs build their child env through home_env
intention: Every scratch-HOME child cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict's proofs start gets its home through home_env, so on every platform it finds its home in the scratch and never reaches the live ~/.cairn.
why: Measured 2026-11-13 on akienyoga9i (Windows) at cairn 96aa5dac7: cairn.tools.scratch.scratch.scratch_home_bypass(<repo>) names 1 site(s) in cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict: cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict/proofs/test_the_live_ticket_tooth_needs_no_home_checkout.py:33 test_the_live_ticket_tooth_passes_with_no_home_checkout. Each builds a child env with HOME set to a scratch by hand, so on Windows, where Path.home() reads USERPROFILE (d95796cdfb9b), the child resolves the LIVE ~/.cairn, and none gets home_env's CAIRN_BUS_ scrub (3301915df481).
traces_to: d95796cdfb9b (a scratch HOME is the child's home on Windows too); 3301915df481; Law 3.
how: D1 each named site builds its env with home_env(home, **extra), keeping its own scrub on the result.

clauses.claim: scratch_home_bypass(<repo>) names no site under cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict
each named proof file is green and a Windows run of it writes nothing under the live ~/.cairn

decisions.text: D1: at cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict/proofs/test_the_live_ticket_tooth_needs_no_home_checkout.py:33 test_the_live_ticket_tooth_passes_with_no_home_checkout, the env is home_env(home, **the site's other keys); a site's own key scrub applies to home_env's result.

D2: cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict/proofs/test_the_live_ticket_tooth_needs_no_home_checkout.py gains test_every_scratch_home_child_here_gets_its_env_from_home_env (clause 1 in PROVES): scratch_home_bypass over the component dir is [], so a hollow of D1 (the hand env restored) reds a tooth. The existing teeth were green at main on Linux, so without it the hollow could not red. Measured 2026-11-13 on Windows: green; hollow red naming the hand-env line.

measured.what: scratch_home_bypass over the repo, sites under cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict
measured.how: py -3 -c scratch.scratch_home_bypass(Path('.')) in cairn at 96aa5dac7 on akienyoga9i
